title: I Do Not Wish to Add Any More
summary: A page that refuses every object added to it, enforcing Huebler's 1969 statement as browser physics.
mechanism: A MutationObserver removes any newly added DOM element (including console-appended nodes) while a tally counts refusals, never additions.
references: Douglas Huebler, statement for January 5-31, 1969 (Seth Siegelaub)
